messages:
OpsBot: ALERT: elevated error rate detected for /v1/generate and /v1/embeddings — tokenization-service OOMs in eu-2 and apac-1 (5xx + 429). 5m error rate spike >= 8% :rotating_light:
Aisha Khan: paging Kai (oncall) — please ack and triage. tagging infra team in case it's a mem leak.
Kai Ito: acked. jumping in — pulling logs now.
Jamal Ortiz: I’m available if we need quick config toggles for dedicated pools.
Kai Ito: root cause looks like tokenization-service worker processes ramping memory over time, GC not reclaiming. reproducing locally with long prompts. confirmed OOM at ~3.6GB for several containers.
Aisha Khan: impact? customer-facing?
Kai Ito: API errors surface as 500/429 for generation and embeddings in eu/apac only. Hosted us regions ok. Rough estimate: ~12% of requests in those regions affected, affecting both hosted and private (private customers using our tokenizer image).
Maria Chen: drafting status page initial. Suggest short, neutral wording + mitigation note. dropping draft below for review.
Maria Chen: ```The Redwood platform is experiencing elevated errors for generation and embeddings in Europe and APAC regions due to tokenization service instability. Engineers are investigating and mitigating. Some requests may return 5xx or 429. We will provide updates every 30 minutes.```
Tara Lopez: looks good. add which endpoints and affected timeframe placeholder so customers can triage. e.g., list /v1/generate, /v1/embeddings.
Maria Chen: updated draft: ```We’re investigating elevated errors for /v1/generate and /v1/embeddings in EU and APAC. Engineers have identified instability in the tokenization service and are working on a mitigation. Some requests may result in 5xx or 429 responses. Affected customers may see increased latency or errors. Next update in 30 minutes.```
Kai Ito: mitigation plan: 1) scale tokenization workers in eu-2/apac-1 by +30% to reduce load, 2) roll out emergency image with adjusted mem limits and a GC tweak to canary hosts, 3) enable fallback tokenizer (slower, stateless) for sessions that hit repeated errors. Doing step 1 now.
Jamal Ortiz: I can flip fallback toggle for dedicated customers who opt in — ping me the list.
Aisha Khan: internal comms: short bulletin to CS + sales with guidance (how to interpret errors, suggested customer messaging). Maria can you add a short copy for CS?
Maria Chen: CS copy draft: "We are currently investigating increased errors for generation and embeddings in EU/APAC caused by a tokenization instability. Engineers are rolling mitigations; customers using dedicated/private deployments can request a temporary fallback to a stateless tokenizer. We will update as mitigations progress."
Kai Ito: scaling started — +40% workers in eu-2, apac-1 upscaling queued. memory profile shows fewer OOMs now on canary.
OpsBot: Deploy bot: canary image with GC tweak promoted to 2 hosts in eu-2 (deploy id: dpl-202203).
Kai Ito: canary looks stable for 6m with reduced OOMs. moving to staged rollout.
Tara Lopez: Maria, hold public update until we confirm staged rollout reduces errors for 15m, then publish initial + note about mitigation. Also prepare a follow-up template for 30m update and resolved notice.
Maria Chen: added 30m update template: ```Update: Engineering has deployed a mitigated tokenizer image to canaries and begun staged rollout to eu and apac. Error rates have decreased but some requests may still fail. We will continue to monitor and expand the rollout. Next update in 30 minutes or sooner.```
Aisha Khan: tagging Statuspage Bot to queue publish when Kai gives thumbs up. @Statuspage Bot can you stand by? :white_check_mark:
Statuspage Bot: Ready to publish when given the OK. Remember to include affected components and impact severity.
Kai Ito: staged rollout complete in eu-2, apac-1 (50% of hosts). error rate in impacted regions down from 12% -> 2.8% over last 10m. I recommend publish now with mitigation note.
Tara Lopez: +1. Maria — publish initial update with mitigation detail and add customer guidance for dedicated/private (how to opt in to fallback).
Maria Chen: publishing now. Draft being sent to Statuspage Bot.```
Statuspage Bot: Published: 2023-11-04T14:12:03Z — Title: "Partial service errors in EU & APAC — tokenization instability" — Impact: Partial outage — Affected: /v1/generate, /v1/embeddings — Mitigation: staged rollout of patched tokenizer image and fallback option.
Aisha Khan: posting internal bulletin to #customer-success with CS copy + escalation contacts.
Jamal Ortiz: flipping fallback for three dedicated customers who requested it — done.
Kai Ito: continue monitoring; setting alert threshold lower to catch regressions.
Maria Chen: scheduling 30m follow-up. I also created resolved template: ```Resolved: The tokenization instability has been mitigated via staged rollout and fallback options. Error rates have returned to baseline. We will perform a post-incident review and follow up with affected customers."```
Tara Lopez: thanks team. once resolved publish resolved notice and send PR for postmortem. cc: eng-runtime, eng-ml.
Kai Ito: +1 — leaving notes in the incident tracker. Will start a postmortem doc after cool-down.
Aisha Khan: great work. if anything changes ping in this thread. closing paging loop. :handshake:
